import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()

## User guide

You can use this user interface to store JSON that are accessible through the user interface and an HTTP API.

- Copy and paste, drag and drop a JSON file or directly type in the editors above.  
You can also click on "load JSON from URL" button to load your JSON data from a URL (Must be https).  
You can also click on "Browse JSON file" button to load your JSON data from a local file.

- If you want to protect your JSON data from modification and deletion, fill in the "security key" field.  
If you want to protect access to your JSON data, check the "private" checkbox field.

- Clicks on "Save" button in order to save your JSON data.  
The URI to directly access this JSON will be displayed.

Note: JSON data is limited to 100 KB per bin.

You can also use a REST API, see below.

```js
function getISOWeek(date = new Date()) {
  const d = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), date.getUTCMonth(), date.getUTCDate()));
  const dayNum = d.getUTCDay() || 7;
  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 4 - dayNum);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(),0,1));
  const weekNo = Math.ceil((((d - yearStart)/86400000)+1)/7);
  return { year: d.getUTCFullYear(), week: weekNo };
}
```
Seed string `${year}-W${pad(week)}-PRISMA`.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Start the saved project and publish readiness only after both HTTP checks pass.
set -euo pipefail
cd "${PROJECT_DIR:?}"
: "${OPENCODE_WEB_DIR:?}" "${APP_URL:?}"
PORT="${APP_PORT:-3000}"
export PORT
startup_timeout="${STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-600}"
[[ "$startup_timeout" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || { echo 'STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer.' >&2; exit 1; }
/usr/bin/time -p test -f start.sh
/usr/bin/time -p bash -n start.sh
current_commit="${CHECKPOINT_COMMIT:-}"
previous_commit=""
[[ ! -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/served-commit" ]] || previous_commit="$(/usr/bin/time -p cat "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/served-commit")"
# Reuse an in-flight build for this checkpoint when a readiness retry returns.
starting=false
if [[ -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/starting-commit" ]] && [[ "$(/usr/bin/time -p cat "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/starting-commit")" == "$current_commit" ]] && /usr/bin/time -p tmux has-session -t app-server 2>/dev/null; then
  starting=true
fi
if [[ "${RESTART_APP:-false}" == true ]] || { [[ "$starting" == false ]] && { [[ -n "$current_commit" && "$previous_commit" != "$current_commit" ]] || ! /usr/bin/time -p curl --fail --silent --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null; }; }; then
  /usr/bin/time -p rm -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/ready-preview-url"
  /usr/bin/time -p tmux kill-session -t app-server 2>/dev/null || true
  /usr/bin/time -p node "${RUNTIME_DIR:?}/scripts/reclaim-preview-port.mjs"
  /usr/bin/time -p /usr/bin/printf '%s' "$current_commit" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/starting-commit"
  # Pass paths through tmux's environment; keep the script in the foreground.
  /usr/bin/time -p tmux new-session -d -s app-server -c "$PROJECT_DIR" \
    -e "RUNTIME_DIR=${RUNTIME_DIR:?}" -e "OPENCODE_WEB_DIR=$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR" -e "PORT=$PORT" -e "STARTUP_LOG=$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.log" \
    'bash start.sh > "$STARTUP_LOG" 2>&1'
fi
ready=false
for ((attempt=0; attempt<(startup_timeout + 1) / 2; attempt++)); do
  /usr/bin/time -p tmux has-session -t app-server 2>/dev/null || { echo 'Startup process exited. Inspect app.log.' >&2; exit 1; }
  if /usr/bin/time -p curl --fail --silent --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null; then
    ready=true
    break
  fi
  /usr/bin/time -p tmux has-session -t app-server 2>/dev/null || { echo 'Startup process exited. Inspect app.log.' >&2; exit 1; }
  /usr/bin/time -p sleep 2
done
[[ "$ready" == true ]] || { echo "Local startup failed after ${startup_timeout}s. Inspect app.log." >&2; exit 75; }
/usr/bin/time -p rm -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/starting-commit"
# Local readiness is independent of a temporary public tunnel failure.
/usr/bin/time -p /usr/bin/printf '%s' "$current_commit" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/served-commit"
for ((attempt=0; attempt<12; attempt++)); do
  status="$(/usr/bin/time -p curl --silent --show-error --location --max-time 10 --output "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/public-readiness.log" --write-out '%{http_code}' "$APP_URL")" || status=000
  if [[ "$status" == 2* ]]; then
    /usr/bin/time -p /usr/bin/printf '%s' "$APP_URL" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/ready-preview-url"
    if [[ -n "${OPENCODE_CONTROL_PORT:-}" ]]; then
      /usr/bin/time -p curl --fail --silent --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_CONTROL_PORT/omgithub/heartbeat" >/dev/null || true
    fi
    echo 'Local and public preview are ready.'
    exit 0
  fi
  if [[ "$status" == 4* && "$status" != 408 && "$status" != 429 ]]; then
    echo "Public preview rejected the request (HTTP $status). Inspect public-readiness.log." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  /usr/bin/time -p sleep 2
done
echo 'Public preview did not become ready.' >&2
exit 75

import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

/* Canvas renderer for the light board. All art is procedural. */

const TAU = Math.PI * 2

function easeOutCubic(t) {
  return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3)
}

function easeInOutCubic(t) {
  return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2
}

function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
  const radius = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2)
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y)
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, radius)
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, radius)
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, radius)
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, radius)
  ctx.closePath()
}

function partialPoints(points, progress) {
  if (points.length < 2 || progress <= 0) return []
  if (progress >= 1) return points
  let total = 0
  const lengths = []
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
    const a = points[i - 1]
    const b = points[i]
    const length = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y)
    lengths.push(length)
    total += length
  }
  const target = total * progress
  const result = [points[0]]
  let walked = 0
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
    const segment = lengths[i - 1]
    if (walked + segment <= target) {
      result.push(points[i])
      walked += segment
      continue
    }
    const remain = target - walked
    const t = segment === 0 ? 0 : remain / segment
    const a = points[i - 1]
    const b = points[i]
    result.push({ x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t })
    break
  }
  return result
}

export function createBoardRenderer(canvas) {
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true })
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches || false
  const view = { width: 0, height: 0, dpr: 1, pad: 0, cell: 0, inner: 0 }

  function resize() {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
    const width = Math.max(1, rect.width)
    const height = Math.max(1, rect.height)
    const dpr = Math.min(2.25, window.devicePixelRatio || 1)
    if (view.width === width && view.height === height && view.dpr === dpr) return
    view.width = width
    view.height = height
    view.dpr = dpr
    canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr)
    canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr)
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0)
    const size = Math.min(width, height)
    view.pad = size * 0.035
    view.inner = size - view.pad * 2
  }

  function geometry(puzzle) {
    resize()
    const size = Math.min(view.width, view.height)
    const pad = view.pad
    const inner = view.inner
    const cell = inner / Math.max(puzzle.w, puzzle.h)
    return { size, pad, inner, cell }
  }

  function cellAt(clientX, clientY, puzzle) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
    const { pad, cell } = geometry(puzzle)
    const x = clientX - rect.left
    const y = clientY - rect.top
    const gx = Math.floor((x - pad) / cell)
    const gy = Math.floor((y - pad) / cell)
    if (gx < 0 || gy < 0 || gx >= puzzle.w || gy >= puzzle.h) return null
    return { x: gx, y: gy }
  }

  function centerOf(puzzle, cellInfo, geo) {
    return {
      x: geo.pad + (cellInfo.x + 0.5) * geo.cell,
      y: geo.pad + (cellInfo.y + 0.5) * geo.cell,
    }
  }

  function drawBackground(geo, now) {
    const { pad, inner, cell } = geo
    const radius = Math.min(28, cell * 0.55)
    const boardX = pad
    const boardY = pad
    const boardSize = inner

    const outerGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      boardX + boardSize * 0.5,
      boardY + boardSize * 0.42,
      boardSize * 0.1,
      boardX + boardSize * 0.5,
      boardY + boardSize * 0.5,
      boardSize * 0.72,
    )
    outerGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(66, 210, 255, 0.075)')
    outerGlow.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(96, 78, 255, 0.035)')
    outerGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(5, 7, 17, 0)')
    ctx.fillStyle = outerGlow
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, view.width, view.height)

    roundRect(ctx, boardX - 1, boardY - 1, boardSize + 2, boardSize + 2, radius + 1)
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3, 6, 16, 0.72)'
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(112, 150, 255, 0.14)'
    ctx.lineWidth = 1
    ctx.stroke()

    roundRect(ctx, boardX, boardY, boardSize, boardSize, radius)
    const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(boardX, boardY, boardX + boardSize, boardY + boardSize)
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#081127')
    bg.addColorStop(0.5, '#060b1c')
    bg.addColorStop(1, '#0a0a1d')
    ctx.fillStyle = bg
    ctx.fill()

    ctx.save()
    roundRect(ctx, boardX, boardY, boardSize, boardSize, radius)
    ctx.clip()

    for (let y = 0; y < 9; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < 9; x++) {
        const tx = boardX + x * cell
        const ty = boardY + y * cell
        const tone = (x + y) % 2 === 0 ? 0.018 : 0.03
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(160, 195, 255, ${tone})`
        roundRect(ctx, tx + cell * 0.045, ty + cell * 0.045, cell * 0.91, cell * 0.91, cell * 0.16)
        ctx.fill()
      }
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120, 160, 255, 0.075)'
    ctx.lineWidth = 1
    for (let i = 1; i < 9; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(boardX + i * cell, boardY)
      ctx.lineTo(boardX + i * cell, boardY + boardSize)
      ctx.stroke()
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(boardX, boardY + i * cell)
      ctx.lineTo(boardX + boardSize, boardY + i * cell)
      ctx.stroke()
    }

    const sweep = (now * 0.000035) % 1
    const sweepGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(boardX, boardY + boardSize * (sweep - 0.2), boardX + boardSize, boardY + boardSize * (sweep + 0.1))
    sweepGradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(94, 243, 255, 0)')
    sweepGradient.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(94, 243, 255, 0.028)')
    sweepGradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 95, 220, 0)')
    ctx.fillStyle = sweepGradient
    ctx.fillRect(boardX, boardY, boardSize, boardSize)

    ctx.restore()
    return { boardX, boardY, boardSize, radius }
  }

  function drawWalls(puzzle, geo) {
    const { pad, cell } = geo
    for (const wall of puzzle.walls) {
      const x = pad + wall.x * cell + cell * 0.055
      const y = pad + wall.y * cell + cell * 0.055
      const w = cell * 0.89
      const r = cell * 0.16
      roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, w, r)
      const fill = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x + w, y + w)
      fill.addColorStop(0, '#111a35')
      fill.addColorStop(1, '#070a18')
      ctx.fillStyle = fill
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(126, 156, 255, 0.16)'
      ctx.lineWidth = 1
      ctx.stroke()

      ctx.save()
      roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, w, r)
      ctx.clip()
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(126, 156, 255, 0.07)'
      ctx.lineWidth = 1
      for (let d = -w; d < w * 2; d += cell * 0.16) {
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.moveTo(x + d, y)
        ctx.lineTo(x + d - w, y + w)
        ctx.stroke()
      }
      const sheen = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + w)
      sheen.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055)')
      sheen.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)')
      sheen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)')
      ctx.fillStyle = sheen
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, w)
      ctx.restore()

      if ((wall.x * 7 + wall.y * 13) % 5 === 0) {
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.arc(x + w * 0.72, y + w * 0.3, Math.max(1.2, cell * 0.022), 0, TAU)
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(94, 243, 255, 0.42)'
        ctx.fill()
      }
    }
  }

  function drawBeam(puzzle, state, geo, now) {
    const { pad, cell } = geo
    const points = state.trace.points.map((point) => ({
      x: pad + (point.x + 0.5) * cell,
      y: pad + (point.y + 0.5) * cell,
    }))
    const progress = easeOutCubic(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.beamProgress)))
    const visible = partialPoints(points, reduceMotion ? 1 : progress)
    if (visible.length < 2) return

    const solved = Boolean(state.solved)
    const color = solved ? '255, 214, 120' : '94, 243, 255'
    const secondary = solved ? '255, 167, 92' : '180, 112, 255'

    ctx.save()
    roundRect(ctx, pad, pad, geo.inner, geo.inner, Math.min(28, cell * 0.55))
    ctx.clip()
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round'

    const path = () => {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(visible[0].x, visible[0].y)
      for (let i = 1; i < visible.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(visible[i].x, visible[i].y)
    }

    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'
    path()
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color}, 0.09)`
    ctx.lineWidth = cell * 0.7
    ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${color}, 0.55)`
    ctx.shadowBlur = cell * 0.7
    ctx.stroke()

    path()
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color}, 0.22)`
    ctx.lineWidth = cell * 0.28
    ctx.shadowBlur = cell * 0.45
    ctx.stroke()

    path()
    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(visible[0].x, visible[0].y, visible[visible.length - 1].x, visible[visible.length - 1].y)
    gradient.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${color}, 0.95)`)
    gradient.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(246, 251, 255, 0.98)')
    gradient.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${secondary}, 0.95)`)
    ctx.strokeStyle = gradient
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.6, cell * 0.055)
    ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${color}, 0.9)`
    ctx.shadowBlur = cell * 0.35
    ctx.stroke()

    path()
    ctx.setLineDash([cell * 0.11, cell * 0.52])
    ctx.lineDashOffset = reduceMotion ? 0 : -(now * 0.11)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72)'
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, cell * 0.018)
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.setLineDash([])

    if (!reduceMotion && !solved) {
      for (const point of visible.slice(1, -1)) {
        const flicker = 0.35 + 0.25 * Math.sin(now * 0.01 + point.x * 0.2)
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.arc(point.x, point.y, cell * 0.045, 0, TAU)
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${flicker})`
        ctx.fill()
      }
    }
    ctx.restore()
  }

  function drawCrystal(puzzle, index, state, geo, now) {
    const { cell } = geo
    const c = centerOf(puzzle, puzzle.crystals[index], geo)
    const lit = state.trace.lit.includes(index)
    const pulse = lit && !reduceMotion ? 1 + Math.sin(now * 0.005 + index * 1.7) * 0.07 : 1
    const radius = cell * 0.19 * pulse
    const solved = state.solved

    ctx.save()
    ctx.translate(c.x, c.y)

    if (lit) {
      const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, cell * 0.55)
      halo.addColorStop(0, solved ? 'rgba(255, 223, 150, 0.5)' : 'rgba(255, 95, 220, 0.38)')
      halo.addColorStop(0.45, solved ? 'rgba(255, 190, 100, 0.14)' : 'rgba(255, 95, 220, 0.12)')
      halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 95, 220, 0)')
      ctx.fillStyle = halo
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(0, 0, cell * 0.55, 0, TAU)
      ctx.fill()
    }

    ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 4)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, -radius)
    ctx.lineTo(radius, 0)
    ctx.lineTo(0, radius)
    ctx.lineTo(-radius, 0)
    ctx.closePath()
    const fill = ctx.createLinearGradient(-radius, -radius, radius, radius)
    if (lit) {
      fill.addColorStop(0, solved ? '#fff6d7' : '#ffe4fb')
      fill.addColorStop(0.5, solved ? '#ffcf70' : '#ff6bdc')
      fill.addColorStop(1, solved ? '#ff9f43' : '#9a5cff')
    } else {
      fill.addColorStop(0, '#2c1746')
      fill.addColorStop(1, '#130b27')
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = fill
    ctx.shadowColor = lit ? (solved ? 'rgba(255, 207, 112, 0.9)' : 'rgba(255, 95, 220, 0.85)') : 'rgba(255, 95, 220, 0.2)'
    ctx.shadowBlur = lit ? cell * 0.4 : cell * 0.1
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = lit ? 'rgba(255, 244, 255, 0.9)' : 'rgba(255, 95, 220, 0.38)'
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, cell * 0.022)
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.restore()

    if (!lit) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, cell * 0.28, 0, TAU)
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 95, 220, 0.16)'
      ctx.lineWidth = 1
      ctx.setLineDash([2, 5])
      ctx.stroke()
      ctx.setLineDash([])
    } else if (!reduceMotion) {
      const sparkle = (now * 0.002 + index) % 1
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(c.x, c.y - cell * (0.32 + sparkle * 0.1), Math.max(1, cell * 0.016 * (1 - sparkle)), 0, TAU)
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${0.65 * (1 - sparkle)})`
      ctx.fill()
    }
  }

  function drawMirror(puzzle, index, state, geo, now) {
    const { cell } = geo
    const mirror = puzzle.mirrors[index]
    const c = centerOf(puzzle, mirror, geo)
    const baseAngle = state.angleAnims?.[index]
    let angle = (state.angles?.[index] ?? 0) * Math.PI / 180
    if (baseAngle) {
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - baseAngle.start) / baseAngle.duration)
      angle = (baseAngle.from + (baseAngle.to - baseAngle.from) * easeInOutCubic(t)) * Math.PI / 180
    }
    const hinted = state.hintIndex === index
    const hovered = state.hovered && state.hovered.x === mirror.x && state.hovered.y === mirror.y
    const solved = state.solved

    if (hinted) {
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(now * 0.008)
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, cell * (0.34 + pulse * 0.04), 0, TAU)
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 207, 112, ${0.5 + pulse * 0.35})`
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.4, cell * 0.025)
      ctx.setLineDash([cell * 0.08, cell * 0.06])
      ctx.lineDashOffset = -now * 0.02
      ctx.stroke()
      ctx.setLineDash([])
    }

    ctx.save()
    ctx.translate(c.x, c.y)

    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(0, 0, cell * 0.29, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fillStyle = hovered ? 'rgba(94, 243, 255, 0.09)' : 'rgba(10, 16, 38, 0.65)'
    ctx.fill()

    ctx.rotate(angle)
    const length = cell * 0.31
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-length, 0, length, 0)
    grad.addColorStop(0, solved ? 'rgba(255, 207, 112, 0.95)' : 'rgba(134, 236, 255, 0.92)')
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98)')
    grad.addColorStop(1, solved ? 'rgba(255, 160, 80, 0.95)' : 'rgba(154, 123, 255, 0.95)')
    ctx.strokeStyle = grad
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, cell * 0.075)
    ctx.shadowColor = solved ? 'rgba(255, 207, 112, 0.8)' : 'rgba(94, 243, 255, 0.7)'
    ctx.shadowBlur = hinted ? cell * 0.45 : cell * 0.25
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-length, 0)
    ctx.lineTo(length, 0)
    ctx.stroke()

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(-length, 0, Math.max(1.6, cell * 0.045), 0, TAU)
    ctx.arc(length, 0, Math.max(1.6, cell * 0.045), 0, TAU)
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)'
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.restore()

    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, cell * 0.07, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6, 10, 24, 0.9)'
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)'
    ctx.lineWidth = 1
    ctx.stroke()

    if (hinted) {
      const bob = Math.sin(now * 0.005) * cell * 0.02
      ctx.save()
      ctx.translate(c.x, c.y - cell * 0.55 + bob)
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(-cell * 0.08, -cell * 0.03)
      ctx.lineTo(cell * 0.08, -cell * 0.03)
      ctx.lineTo(cell * 0.08, cell * 0.035)
      ctx.lineTo(cell * 0.13, cell * 0.035)
      ctx.lineTo(0, cell * 0.15)
      ctx.lineTo(-cell * 0.13, cell * 0.035)
      ctx.lineTo(-cell * 0.08, cell * 0.035)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 207, 112, 0.92)'
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 207, 112, 0.7)'
      ctx.shadowBlur = cell * 0.25
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.restore()
    }
  }

  function drawEmitter(puzzle, state, geo, now) {
    const { cell } = geo
    const c = centerOf(puzzle, puzzle.emitter, geo)
    const solved = state.solved
    const pulse = reduceMotion ? 1 : 1 + Math.sin(now * 0.004) * 0.06

    ctx.save()
    ctx.translate(c.x, c.y)

    const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, cell * 0.58)
    halo.addColorStop(0, solved ? 'rgba(255, 214, 120, 0.45)' : 'rgba(94, 243, 255, 0.32)')
    halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(94, 243, 255, 0)')
    ctx.fillStyle = halo
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(0, 0, cell * 0.58, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()

    ctx.rotate(reduceMotion ? 0 : now * 0.00035)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(0, 0, cell * 0.28 * pulse, 0, TAU)
    ctx.strokeStyle = solved ? 'rgba(255, 214, 120, 0.75)' : 'rgba(94, 243, 255, 0.7)'
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, cell * 0.025)
    ctx.setLineDash([cell * 0.09, cell * 0.07])
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.setLineDash([])
    ctx.rotate(-(reduceMotion ? 0 : now * 0.00035))

    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(0, 0, cell * 0.13, 0, TAU)
    const core = ctx.createRadialGradient(-cell * 0.04, -cell * 0.04, 0, 0, 0, cell * 0.16)
    core.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff')
    core.addColorStop(0.35, solved ? '#ffcf70' : '#8ff8ff')
    core.addColorStop(1, solved ? 'rgba(255, 159, 67, 0.2)' : 'rgba(43, 184, 255, 0.25)')
    ctx.fillStyle = core
    ctx.shadowColor = solved ? 'rgba(255, 207, 112, 0.95)' : 'rgba(94, 243, 255, 0.95)'
    ctx.shadowBlur = cell * 0.4
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.restore()
  }

  function drawParticles(state, geo) {
    const { pad, cell } = geo
    if (!state.particles?.length) return
    ctx.save()
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'
    for (const particle of state.particles) {
      const alpha = Math.max(0, particle.life / particle.maxLife)
      const x = pad + (particle.gx + 0.5) * cell
      const y = pad + (particle.gy + 0.5) * cell
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(x, y, Math.max(0.8, particle.size * cell * alpha), 0, TAU)
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${particle.color}, ${alpha * 0.85})`
      ctx.fill()
    }
    ctx.restore()
  }

  function drawCursor(state, geo, now) {
    if (!state.showCursor || !state.cursor) return
    const { pad, cell } = geo
    const x = pad + state.cursor.x * cell + cell * 0.08
    const y = pad + state.cursor.y * cell + cell * 0.08
    const size = cell * 0.84
    const pulse = 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(now * 0.008)
    roundRect(ctx, x, y, size, size, cell * 0.18)
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(94, 243, 255, ${0.5 + pulse * 0.35})`
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.4, cell * 0.022)
    ctx.setLineDash([cell * 0.12, cell * 0.07])
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.setLineDash([])
  }

  function render(state, now = performance.now()) {
    const puzzle = state.puzzle
    if (!puzzle) return
    const geo = geometry(puzzle)
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, view.width, view.height)

    let shakeX = 0
    let shakeY = 0
    if (!reduceMotion && state.shake > 0) {
      const amount = state.shake
      shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * amount
      shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * amount
    }

    ctx.save()
    ctx.translate(shakeX, shakeY)

    const board = drawBackground(geo, now)
    ctx.save()
    roundRect(ctx, board.boardX, board.boardY, board.boardSize, board.boardSize, board.radius)
    ctx.clip()
    drawBeam(puzzle, state, geo, now)
    drawWalls(puzzle, geo)
    for (let i = 0; i < puzzle.crystals.length; i++) drawCrystal(puzzle, i, state, geo, now)
    for (let i = 0; i < puzzle.mirrors.length; i++) drawMirror(puzzle, i, state, geo, now)
    drawEmitter(puzzle, state, geo, now)
    drawParticles(state, geo)
    drawCursor(state, geo, now)
    ctx.restore()

    if (!reduceMotion && state.solved) {
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - (state.solvedAt || now)) / 900)
      if (t < 1) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 235, 185, ${0.13 * (1 - t)})`
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, view.width, view.height)
      }
    }

    ctx.restore()
  }

  return { resize, cellAt, render, view }
}

  if (state.phase !== 'playing' || state.solved) return;
  const mirror = state.puzzle.mirrors[index]; if (!mirror) return;
  const oldOrient = state.orientations[index];
  state.orientations[index] ^= 1;
  state.turns++;
  if (state.hintIndex === index) state.hintIndex = -1;
  state.angles[index] = (state.angles[index] ?? (oldOrient?45:-45)) + 90;
  state.angleAnims[index] = { from: state.angles[index] - 90, to: state.angles[index], start: performance.now(), duration: 180 };
  const previousLit = state.trace?.lit.length || 0;

  state.beamProgress = 0;
  state.beamChangedAt = performance.now();
  state.showCursor = fromKeyboard ? true : state.showCursor;
  // sounds
  audio.rotate();
  const newLit = state.trace.lit.length;
  if (newLit > previousLit) {

    audio.crystal(newLit-1);

  saveRun();

}

## Objective
- Build a 2D turn-based puzzle game focused on solving puzzles and earning points, with a weekly online leaderboard ("2d sıra tabanlı oyun ... bulmaca çözme ve puan ... haftalık en yüksek sıralamalı online sıra").

## Requirements
- 2D, turn-based gameplay centered on puzzle solving and scoring.
- Weekly highest-score leaderboard/ranking.
- User communicates in Turkish; game UI should be Turkish.

## Decisions
- Game concept: **PRISMA — Haftalık Işık Ligi**, a neon laser/mirror puzzle game.
- Each week has 6 deterministic puzzles generated from the ISO week seed; same board for everyone.
- Each mirror rotation is one turn; goal is to light all crystals with one beam.
- Scoring: base 400 + 120/crystal + 140 per unused turn + 300 perfect bonus + 50×streak − 150/hint.
- Leaderboard is local-first with deterministic weekly rival bots; optional shared server via `window.PRISMA_CONFIG.leaderboardApi` and included Node server (not yet written).
- Vanilla static HTML/CSS/ES modules; no build step, so `package.json` must not be added (default static server treats package projects as unsupported).
- Custom canvas renderer with procedural neon art, WebAudio synth, responsive/mobile support.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created working deterministic puzzle generator/solver in `js/puzzle.js`; tested 360 levels across 60 weeks (par 3–7, generation ~76ms).
- Created `js/week.js` for UTC ISO week keys, reset countdown, formatting.
- Created `js/leaderboard.js` for local league, weekly pace bots, avatars, profile, optional remote API adapter.
- Created `js/audio.js` WebAudio sound synth with mute persistence.
- Created `js/renderer.js` canvas renderer (beam, mirrors, crystals, emitter, walls, particles, cursor, glow).
- Created `js/config.js`, `assets/favicon.svg`.
- Created `index.html` with start screen, header, board, stats/league panels, mobile HUD, modals, toast.
- Created `css/style.css` with full responsive neon-glass design, mobile layouts, modals, leaderboard, start-screen prism art.
- Created `js/app.js` with game state machine, weekly flow, scoring, saving/resuming runs, modals, leaderboard UI, hints/reset, keyboard/touch controls, confetti, debug hooks (`?debug=1`).
- Syntax checks pass for all `js/*.js`.
- Started dev server in tmux session `prisma-dev` on port 3002 (`PORT=3002 bash start.sh`), serving successfully via `http://127.0.0.1:3002/`.
- Installed Playwright Chromium after initial missing-browser error.

### Active
- Browser verification/screenshots of start screen, gameplay, solve flow, leaderboard, mobile layout.
- Fixing issues found during first browser run (none observed yet beyond browser install).
- Still need to add `server/leaderboard-server.mjs`, update `.gitignore`/README with online-mode instructions, and perform final end-to-end test.

### Blocked
- None currently.

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli -s=prisma open ...`, take desktop/mobile screenshots, inspect for visual/functional bugs.
2. Run an end-to-end solve test using `?debug=1` (`window.PRISMA_DEBUG.rotateMirror`, `solveCurrent`, `advanceLevel`) through all 6 levels, submit score, verify leaderboard/rank and run resume.
3. Fix any issues found; verify keyboard focus behavior, modal flow, mobile layout, and local storage resume.
4. Create optional `server/leaderboard-server.mjs` (static files + GET/POST `/api/leaderboard`, `.data/leaderboard.json`, validation, CORS) and add `.data/` to `.gitignore`.
5. Update README with game description, controls, scoring, weekly reset, local vs online leaderboard setup, and include final screenshots.
6. Final check: no console errors, working mobile/desktop, commit changes if appropriate.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: full app shell, start screen, board, modals.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/app.js`: main game logic/state/UI/flows.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/puzzle.js`: deterministic weekly puzzle generation/beam solver.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/renderer.js`: canvas board rendering/effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/leaderboard.js`: local weekly league, bots, optional remote adapter.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/week.js`: ISO week/countdown/format helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: synth sounds.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/config.js`: `window.PRISMA_CONFIG` runtime config.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: visual design/responsive styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/assets/favicon.svg`: favicon.
- `/tmp/prisma-dev.log`: dev server log.

## Important Context
- Dev server is running in tmux session `prisma-dev` on port **3002**; stop/restart with `tmux kill-session -t prisma-dev`.
- `playwright-cli` browser was initially missing; `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` has now installed Chromium/headless shell.
- The default runtime serves only static `index.html`; the planned online server must be run separately and configured via `window.PRISMA_CONFIG = { leaderboardApi: '/api/leaderboard' }` before module load.
- `js/app.js` references a debug API only when URL has `?debug=1`; use it for automated solving.
- Current local leaderboard includes deterministic weekly bots and labels itself "Yerel lig" honestly; remote mode shows real server entries.
- Several last-minute fixes were applied: added canvas `tabindex`, focus handling, keyboard target filtering, fx canvas z-index 90, and resume-save handling.
- Repository changes are uncommitted; git history only has initial `Install OpenCode issue listener` commit.

function hydrateStart() {
  const week = state.week
  $('startWeekNum').textContent = `${week.week}. HAFTA`
  $('startWeekRange').textContent = week.range
  $('panelWeek').textContent = String(week.week).padStart(2, '0')
  if (!$('playerName').value && state.profile.name) $('playerName').value = state.profile.name

  const saved = state.savedRun
  if (saved) {
    const prefix = saved.pending ? 'Bölüm sonucu hazır' : `Bölüm ${saved.levelIndex + 1} / ${MAX_LEVELS}`
    $('startBtnLabel').textContent = 'Devam Et'
    $('resumeHint').textContent = `${prefix} · ${formatScore(saved.totalScore)} puan · kaldığın yerden sürdür.`
    $('newRunBtn').hidden = false
  } else {
    $('startBtnLabel').textContent = 'Haftayı Oyna'
    $('resumeHint').textContent = 'Her hafta aynı altı bulmaca. Herkes aynı tahtada yarışır.'
    $('newRunBtn').hidden = true
  }
  renderStartTop3()
}

function hideStartScreen() {
  const screen = $('startScreen')
  screen.classList.add('is-leaving')
  $('gameLayout').setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false')
  clearTimeout(state.startTimer)
  state.startTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    screen.hidden = true
  }, 620)
}

function showStartScreen() {
  clearTimeout(state.startTimer)
  const screen = $('startScreen')
  screen.hidden = false
  screen.classList.add('is-leaving')
  // Force a frame so the entrance transition always runs after a long session.
  requestAnimationFrame(() => screen.classList.remove('is-leaving'))
  $('gameLayout').setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
  state.phase = 'start'
  state.sessionStart = 0
  state.puzzle = null
  state.pending = null
  state.solved = false
  state.modal = null
  $('modalRoot').hidden = true
  $('modalCard').innerHTML = ''
  document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll')
  hydrateStart()
  renderMiniBoard()
  renderWeekLabels()
  updateCountdownText()
  window.scrollTo(0, 0)
}

# PRISMA — Haftalık Işık Ligi

**Işığı bük, kristalleri uyandır.** PRISMA, her hafta herkese aynı altı bulmacayı sunan, sıra tabanlı bir 2D ışık bulmacası ve haftalık skor ligidir.

![PRISMA oyun ekranı](assets/screenshots/gameplay.png)

## Nasıl oynanır?

- Kaynaktan çıkan tek ışını aynalarla yönlendir ve tüm kristalleri aynı anda uyandır.
- Her ayna dönüşü **bir tur** sayılır. Amaç az turda, yüksek puanla bitirmek.
- Altı bölümün toplamı haftalık skorunu belirler. Aynı hafta içinde en iyi skorun geçerli olur.
- Eşit puanda **daha hızlı tur** üst sıraya geçer.

| Girdi | Eylem |
| --- | --- |
| Aynaya dokun / tıkla | Aynayı 90° döndür |
| `←` `↑` `↓` `→` | Tahtadaki imleci gezdir |
| `Enter` / `Space` | İmlecin üstündeki aynayı döndür |
| `R` | Bölümü sıfırla (seri bozulur) |
| `H` | İpucu aç (−150 puan) |
| `L` | Haftalık ligi aç |
| `?` | Nasıl oynanır |

## Puanlama

Bir bölümün puanı:

```text
400 (bölüm temeli)
+ 120 × kristal sayısı
+ 140 × kullanılmayan tur (tur bütçesi − oynanan tur)
+ 300 (par turunda bitirince kusursuz çözüm)
+ 50 × bölüm serisi
− 150 × ipucu
```

Sıfırlama seriyi sıfırlar. Tur bütçesi aşılırsa verimlilik bonusu kapanır.

## Haftalık lig

- Hafta, **ISO haftası** ve **UTC** saatine göre hesaplanır; yeni hafta pazartesi **00:00 UTC**'de başlar.
- Altı bulmaca, hafta anahtarından deterministik olarak üretilir: aynı haftada herkes aynı tahtaları oynar.
- Varsayılan mod **yerel lig**dir: skorlar tarayıcıda saklanır, haftalık tempolu rakipler tahtayı canlı tutar.
- İsteğe bağlı sunucu ile **canlı lig** açılır: tüm oyuncular aynı sıralamada yarışır.

![Haftalık lig](assets/screenshots/weekly-league.png)

## Çalıştırma

Proje vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript ve ES modülleri kullanır; derleme adımı veya paket bağımlılığı yoktur.

Herhangi bir statik sunucu yeterlidir (ES modülleri için `file://` yerine HTTP gerekir):

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
# http://localhost:8000
```

Bu depodaki çalışma ortamında `start.sh` de kullanılabilir.

## Canlı lig sunucusu (isteğe bağlı)

Sıfır bağımlılıklı küçük bir Node.js sunucusu dahildir. Hem oyunu hem JSON API'yi sunar:

```bash
node server/leaderboard-server.mjs
# http://localhost:4173/?online=1
```

`?online=1` parametresi ligi `/api/leaderboard` adresine bağlar. Farklı bir adres kullanmak için `js/app.js` yüklenmeden önce şunu tanımlayın:

```html
<script>window.PRISMA_CONFIG = { leaderboardApi: '/api/leaderboard' }</script>
```

Sunucu seçenekleri:

```bash
PORT=8080 HOST=127.0.0.1 node server/leaderboard-server.mjs
```

Skorlar `.data/leaderboard.json` dosyasında tutulur (`.gitignore` kapsamındadır). Sunucu her oyuncu ve hafta için yalnızca en iyi skoru saklar; eşit puanda daha hızlı tur kazanır.

### API

```http
GET /api/leaderboard?week=2026-W44
```

```json
{ "week": "2026-W44", "entries": [{ "id": "…", "name": "Işıkçı", "score": 9110, "timeMs": 61000, "levels": 6, "crystals": 17 }] }
```

```http
POST /api/leaderboard?week=2026-W44
Content-Type: application/json

{ "id": "…", "name": "Işıkçı", "score": 9110, "timeMs": 61000, "levels": 6, "crystals": 17 }
```

Yanıt, güncel sıralamayı ve `improved` bilgisini döndürür. Bu ligde hesap doğrulaması yoktur; skorlar istemci tarafından gönderilir. Arkadaş grupları ve küçük etkinlikler için tasarlanmıştır, rekabetçi bir hile koruması sunmaz. İstemci, sunucuya ulaşamazsa yerel lige düşer.

## Proje yapısı

```text
index.html                 Oyun kabuğu, başlangıç ekranı, modaller
css/style.css              Neon cam arayüz ve duyarlı düzen
js/app.js                  Oyun durumu, akış, puanlama, arayüz
js/puzzle.js               Deterministik bulmaca üretimi ve ışın çözücü
js/renderer.js             Canvas tahta çizimi ve efektler
js/leaderboard.js          Yerel lig, haftalık rakipler, API istemcisi
js/week.js                 ISO hafta, geri sayım ve biçimlendirme
js/audio.js                WebAudio ses sentezi
js/config.js               Çalışma zamanı yapılandırması
server/leaderboard-server.mjs  Statik sunucu + paylaşımlı lig API'si
assets/                    Favicon ve ekran görüntüleri
```

## Notlar

- Ses ve skor tercihleri tarayıcıda saklanır; oyun içi “sesi kapat” düğmesi kalıcıdır.
- Devam eden tur, sayfa yenilense bile kaldığı yerden sürer.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` desteklenir; hareket azaltıldığında animasyonlar sadeleşir.
- Mobilde dokunmatik tahta, masaüstünde fare ve klavye birlikte çalışır.
- Hata ayıklama: `?debug=1` parametresi `window.PRISMA_DEBUG` yardımcılarını açar.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.
